text: これで　かなり　つかまえやすく　なったぞ！

structure.jp: かなり　つかまえやすく　なったぞ！
structure.en: it has become quite a bit easier to catch!

patterns.name: 〜やすい
patterns.explanation: やすい added to a verb means 'easy to do'; it changes to やすく before なる. つかまえやすく = 'easy to catch'.

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.span: つかまえやすく　なった
patterns.explanation: A describing word with い changed to く plus なる means 'become' that way. つかまえやすく　なった = 'became easier to catch'.
